questions: Should the librarian have to sign in with a password, and should students also sign in, or can anyone just type a name to borrow a book?
Can one student borrow more than one copy of the same book at the same time, and is there a limit on how many books one student can hold?
Do borrowed books have a due date (for example, two weeks), and should the system show which books are overdue?
answers: No, they just give their name.
